## 🔍 FAQs

#### I'm a beginner, can I still join?

Of course! Many of my clients start with little to no gym experience. Sessions are tailored to your current level, and the goal is to help you build confidence, understanding, and a strong foundation at your own pace.

#### What if I have pain/injuries?

That's completely okay! I take an individualised approach and adjust training based on your history, symptoms, and comfort levels. The aim is to help you move and train with more confidence, not push through pain unnecessarily.

#### What should I expect in the first session?

The first session is focused on understanding you. We will go through your goals, training history, lifestyle, movement assessments, and any limitations or concerns you may have. From there, we will start building a plan that works for you.

#### Do you provide programming?

Yes! All clients receive personalised programming through my coaching app, where workouts, progress tracking, and training guidance are organised in one place. Programs are adjusted based on your goals, schedule, and progress.

#### How am I supported outside our sessions?

Support goes beyond our in-person sessions! Clients receive guidance through check-ins, habit support, food journaling feedback, exercise form reviews, and additional resources to help them stay consistent and confident independently.

## 🧠 More About Me

*For those who are curious about the person behind the coaching.*

#### 👩🏻‍💼 Why My Background Matters

Before becoming a Personal Trainer, I studied and worked in Social Work.

Supporting individuals from diverse backgrounds taught me the importance of empathy, behaviour change, and meeting people where they are. These experiences continue to shape how I coach today.

I believe meaningful progress happens when people feel understood, supported, and empowered to take ownership of their journey.

#### 🏀 Sport Has Always Been Part of My Life

Growing up, sport played a significant role in shaping who I am. I was the only girl on my primary school's basketball team before later founding the school's first official girls' basketball team.

Since then, I've explored various interests including strength training, bouldering, dancing, and drumming. Each experience has taught me valuable lessons about resilience, growth, and embracing the learning process.

#### 🌻 My Coaching Philosophy

Fitness is rarely just about workouts.

Many people are balancing work, family responsibilities, stress, injuries, self-doubt, or previous experiences that shape how they approach exercise.

My role isn't simply to prescribe exercises.

It's to help you develop the skills, confidence, and understanding needed to navigate challenges while continuing to move towards your goals.

I believe progress comes from consistency, self-awareness, and learning how to work with life's challenges rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

#### 🌱 My Coaching Journey

My coaching approach has been shaped by mentors from different areas of the industry, including strength training, rehabilitation, sports performance, and lifestyle coaching.

Working with clients from various backgrounds has helped me develop a coaching philosophy centred around collaboration, curiosity, and sustainable progress rather than perfection.

#### ☕ Beyond The Gym

Outside of coaching, you'll probably find me training, exploring new hobbies, spending time with people I care about, or working on community initiatives.

I believe growth extends beyond fitness, and some of life's most meaningful lessons happen outside the gym.
